single.description: A tuple closed by additionalItems alone. It permits at most one element, but says so without maxItems — so the generated slice needs the cap derived from the tuple length, or `["a", "b"]` would decode cleanly against a schema that rejects it.

pair.description: Same for a heterogeneous tuple. It cannot be modelled positionally so it stays an untyped array, but the length cap is still knowable and still enforced.

open.description: Left open, the tuple constrains position 0 only and any number of further elements is allowed, so no cap is emitted.
